Updated header comment: M3 mine.wav entry + PlayMine() throttle rationale + header flag #3 updated (was 'ideally add sfxMine', now 'DONE')

changes.mine.wav: 44100Hz mono 16bit 0.180s — pick-on-stone: 2400+3100+1800Hz metal-pick transient (180 exp decay) + 420+580+280Hz stone resonance body (28 exp decay) + grit noise burst. Shorter/denser than chop.wav (0.30s). Peak=0.840 after normalize(0.84).
changes.mine.wav.meta: AudioImporter ForceUpdate pattern — guid a9f3e2d1c8b7a6f5e4d3c2b1a0f9e8d7, loadType 0, compressionFormat 1, normalize 1, 3D 1 (matches build/alert/ambient .meta pattern)

throttle_rationale.MineInterval: 0.25s — StoneVeinEntity.TakeMineDamage() has entity-level 0.6s guard already; AudioBank-side 0.25s is defense-in-depth for future callers without entity guard. Own _lastMineTime: swapping PlayChop->PlayMine does NOT consume the chop throttle window — a tree chop and mine hit in the same frame no longer share a throttle bucket.
throttle_rationale.entity_guard_preserved: SfxInterval=0.6s / lastSfxTime in StoneVeinEntity.TakeMineDamage() is unchanged

qa_flag.required_scene_action: Assign mine.wav to AudioBank.sfxMine SerializeField on the AudioBank GameObject in the Unity Inspector — same workflow as sfxBuild/sfxAlert/sfxAmbient wired last wave (W-M2-01). Without this assignment PlayMine() gracefully no-ops (null guard) but no sound plays.
qa_flag.verify_criterion: During mining: pick-on-stone sound plays (distinct high-freq transient, NOT the woody axe thunk of PlayChop); chop sound plays when chopping a tree (PlayChop unaffected); no regression on other SFX.
